name: Peaceable queens on a 30 by 30 board
definition: Place the same number m of white and black queens on a standard 30 by 30 chessboard. A white queen may not attack any black queen by a row, column, or diagonal move. Queens of the same color may attack each other. Maximize m.
solution_format: An object with white and black arrays of [row,column] integer coordinates in 0..29.
constraints: The board has 30 rows and 30 columns indexed 0..29.
White and black each have exactly m queens.
No two queens occupy the same square.
No white queen attacks a black queen along a row, column, or diagonal.
Queens of the same color may attack each other.
verification: The checker validates integer coordinates and exact army counts, then tests every white-black pair for row, column, and diagonal attacks.
